verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a government filing portal that holds user accounts and submitted records, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing bot walls on nvsos.gov and esos.nv.gov/orion.nv.gov. None of it says anything about retention policies or user-initiated deletion, so there is no evidence the capability exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
